images.prompt: Photorealistic premium Navratri festival background for a tall phone status poster, with NO people and NO text. Deep emerald green to navy blue softly lit backdrop with warm golden bokeh lights and a delicate hanging marigold toran across the very top. Along the bottom 25%: a festive arrangement on a low surface, with a brass kalash topped with mango leaves and a coconut wrapped in red cloth, glowing clay diyas, red and orange marigolds, red hibiscus flowers and a pair of decorated dandiya sticks, softly lit. The middle and right side are calm, dark and uncluttered, so a person and text can be placed there later. Warm light from the left, elegant and devotional. One continuous full-bleed scene, no bands, borders or panels, no letters, no logos, no deity faces.
